source.public_report: A hard reload can leave favorited DMs blank and group-message member counts at zero until the user clicks a channel.

contract: After a hard reload, direct-message and group-message sidebar entries must render their user identity/member count correctly regardless of whether sidebar categories or channel data arrive first, without requiring a channel click to self-heal.
symptoms: Favorited direct-message rows can render as blank space after startup.
Group-message rows can temporarily show a member count of zero.
The problem is timing-dependent and can disappear after clicking a channel.
reproduction: Use an account with favorited DMs and at least one group message.
Hard reload while making channel-related startup requests slower than sidebar-category loading.
Do not click a channel after startup.
Observe whether DM identity and GM member counts are populated.

runtime.notes: The pinned webapp declares Node ^24 and npm ^11. Confirm exact repository instructions before installing dependencies.

validation.guidance: The strongest regression proof forces both startup orderings instead of relying on an intermittent manual reproduction.
